label: Nurse manager / Leader
values: Nobody finds out from a rumor
mission: Run a unit people want to stay on — and be the one who brings AI in with governance, instead of letting it arrive without.
sub: Ken Adeyemi, MSN, RN, NEA-BC · manager, 46-bed cardiac step-down · 62 direct reports · four vacancies open.
seasonBody: Budget and staffing are the loud things. Retention is the one that quietly decides both, so you made it the through-line and stopped chasing the noise.
seasonMeta: Q3 · 62 direct reports · 4 vacancies · turnover 14.2% and falling · review 30 September

actions.title: Finish the four stay interviews you scheduled
actions.why: Three of the four are your highest flight risks by tenure and shift pattern. You have moved them twice, and both times the reason was something less consequential.
actions.cost: 25 minutes each · your notes, not a form

actions.title: Read the AI-policy draft before Thursday
actions.why: Your own council votes on it, and you are the only person in the room running a governed system already. An abstention here is a decision.

actions.title: Take the two days you have banked
actions.why: You are at 31 accrued days and the policy caps at 30 next month. You will lose them by arithmetic, not by choice.

health.signal: 31 days accrued against a 30-day cap. Losing time by arithmetic.
health.detail: You are the only person on this unit whose time off nobody else is watching. The cap does not care that the unit is short — it will take the days back in September.

family.signal: Friday dinners held nine of eleven weeks.
family.detail: Two misses, both during the vacancy push. Nine out of eleven under those conditions is holding, not slipping.

career.signal: Turnover 14.2% and falling. Two of four vacancies filled this quarter.
career.detail: The season’s actual scoreboard. Turnover has fallen every month since you made retention the through-line — that is causation you can defend.

learning.signal: NEA-BC renewal hours 41 of 75. Governance reading current.
learning.detail: On pace, with the harder half still ahead. Nothing dated is at risk this cycle.

finance.signal: Unit budget variance −1.2%. Nothing personal outstanding.
finance.detail: The unit’s numbers are not in this system and never will be. This line is your own money only, and it is clean.

creative.signal: Three process drafts written. One adopted by a peer unit.
creative.detail: Your assignment-fairness draft is now running on another floor. That is influence without a title change.

service.signal: Stay interviews, council seat, two formal mentees.
service.detail: The highest-leverage domain in your season and it is fully tended. Stay interviews are the intervention with the best evidence behind it, and you are actually doing them.

business.signal: Speaking and consulting paused until the vacancies close.
business.detail: Logged 12 June with an end date. It will not compete for attention until the fourth vacancy is filled.

momentum.label: returned to you this quarter — schedules, meeting prep, policy summaries, and the drafts you no longer start from nothing.
momentum.note: Estimated from your own logged times. Nothing here is read from a staffing system, and nothing is reported to one.
momentum.caption: meeting prep stopped eating Sundays in week 6

reputation.meta: 0 messages to 62 people have left this system unreviewed

risks.what: A performance conversation typed into a prompt
risks.guard: Personnel content is not PHI, and it is not one bit less sensitive. Import refuses on identifier patterns and the nightly lint sweeps what is stored. The system catches it.

risks.what: An AI draft becoming a personnel decision
risks.guard: Nothing produced here is an HR action, an evaluation, or a basis for one. The draft is a draft until a human with authority makes it otherwise. This one is yours to keep.

risks.what: Reaching for an ungoverned window instead
risks.guard: No governed system can reach a chat window it does not run. This one is yours to keep — it is the reason the rails are worth having.

license.scopeNote: Nothing in this system is an HR record, and no output of it is a personnel action. You hold authority over 62 people; the agent holds none, and its tier ceiling does not rise because yours did. Positional authority is not a governance credential — if anything it is the argument for keeping the gates exactly where they are.

signals.title: You will lose banked days to the cap in September
signals.body: 31 accrued against a 30-day ceiling. This is arithmetic, not a judgment about the unit.

signals.title: The compliance module is due 15 September
signals.body: The only dated item on your standing without a plan. Everything else is current.

signals.title: Three stay interviews have moved twice
signals.body: All three are high flight-risk by tenure and shift pattern. Moving them again has a cost you can name.

signals.title: Turnover has fallen every month this year
signals.body: 14.2% and still going. Worth logging before the quarter closes and it becomes background.

opps.title: The AI-policy seat is still unclaimed
opps.body: You are the only manager in the system running a governed setup. That is the qualification.

opps.title: A non-clinical pilot would fit your unit
opps.body: The Institutional Pilot Pack scopes a 30–90 day learning pilot — no patient care, no deployment claim.

opps.title: The peer unit adopted your fairness draft
opps.body: Their manager asked to co-write the next version. Your notes say you meant to reply.

opps.title: Your retention numbers are a case study
opps.body: Twelve months of falling turnover with a named intervention is publishable as written.
